scope: Record a source-specific biographical spelling variant for the name Qurtubi attributes in the thirteenth al-Kawthar interpretation. This is a name-form note, not identity/authentication adjudication.

arabic.span: الثالث عشر : قال هلال بن يساف : هو لا إله إلا الله محمد رسول الله

english.coverage: thirteenth interpretation absent from stored English

source_anchors.locator: vol.20, printed p.216, Sura 108:1, thirteenth interpretation
source_anchors.supports: Qurtubi's edition-bearing name form; Qurtubi introduces this interpretation by saying Hilal stated it.

source_anchors.work: Al-Mizzi, Tahdhib al-Kamal fi Asma al-Rijal
source_anchors.exact_name_form: هلال بن يساف ، ويقال : ابن إساف
source_anchors.supports: A biographical work records Ibn Isaf as an alternate name form for the biographical entry headed Hilal ibn Yasaf al-Ashja'i.

finding.comparison: Qurtubi's هلال بن يساف matches the first form in al-Mizzi's biographical entry; al-Mizzi also records the variant ابن إساف.
finding.transliteration_policy: Keep the Qurtubi witness transliterated as Hilal ibn Yasaf. Add 'also transmitted/recorded as Ibn Isaf' only as a source-specific name-form variant, clearly separated from Qurtubi's wording.
finding.identity_limit: This bibliographical match does not prove that Qurtubi's named source is the same individual described by al-Mizzi; preserve this as a research lead pending scholarly identification review.
finding.route_limit: Qurtubi's قال is an attribution in his tafsir text; it does not supply an isnad. Do not import the biographical narrator's hadith network as a route for this tafsir proposition.
finding.preference_limit: Qurtubi later prefers the first and second interpretations; this thirteenth named view remains reported, not preferred.
